Subnautica was always a key part of my childhood, both the original and Below Zero.

And now Subnautica 2 is here and so far the early access has been great! Amazing watching another game by these amazing devs grow.

I know the game is in early access, but this is honestly ridiculous for AMD users. How do you release a game without properly testing it on such common hardware? A lot of people, including me, are having serious problems on AMD systems. Right now the game is completely unplayable and won't even launch.

I expected bugs and performance issues because it's early access, but not being able to start the game at all is just unacceptable. I really hope the AMD related issues get fixed soon.

I'm sorry, but I've got to be the person to say it. I hold massive respect for those over at Unknown Worlds, but their game is not ready yet. I've played several other early access games such as Build 42 Project Zomboid and 7 Days to Day Alpha; and those are still leagues better despite their smaller dev teams of the time. Subnautica 2 just feels TOO rushed, even with all the time constraints coming from Unknown's higher ups at Krafton.
The base building aspects of Subnautica 2 are an absolute nightmare, with the only tool available to help you being one that barely works at all? Not happy. Tried to refund a section of my base and it immediately took items, workstations and lockers from a room I had built to entirely separate 3 sections of my base to re-do the middle section. Then adding them to a storage beacon that can't be scrolled through means I have to go collect MORE materials and that becomes a huge drag on its own.
Like I said earlier, I hold huge respect for Unknown Worlds and their Dev Team but they really need to get this sh*t sorted out. I'm going to be waiting to play again until the next update that at least takes a good stab at these problems.

I just think the game is boring. Legit feels like all there is to do is swim around and listen to drawn out robot dialogue. It's advertised as a survival game but I can't even fight anything? Half the challenge is gone right there. Exploring felt underwhelming as hell. Discovering blueprints for chairs, beds, dining tables, you know... BASIC furniture that my character should already know how to craft was not exciting. Whenever I ran into an enemy all I had to do to escape was simply swim away.

The lack of urgency, excitement, and challenge really makes this game feel more like a swimming simulator rather than survival adventure.

Ok, this game is great. It 100% has issues, but it is still an amazing game.

The environment's are really pretty and unique, the creature designs are very intriguing and good looking, and the lore is very mysterious; even rivaling the first game in mystery.

Many people say that Krafton's EULA is bad, and unnecessary for Subanutiaca 2. But, you have to know that Krafton also owns PUBG which is why there are several terms that state that Krafton has the right to remove you from accessing the game at any time for any reason and with no guarantee of a refund for dealing with something like hackers, scammers, and more.

Overall,
this game does have issues, but they are small issues and they are being worked on to be fixed. I would rank this game just bellow the first game and 100% above Bellow Zero.

Please get this game and support the dev team with their hard work.

tldr.text: Very Positive (93%): players love the story, characters, and art.
The main complaint is bugs and crashes, which can stop the game from launching.

details.text: Bug and crash complaints have dropped from 12% of all reviews to 4% of recent ones, so recent players report fewer problems.
Players with the fewest hours are the least positive, and one recent reviewer says a crash stops them from playing at all, so check launch reports before buying.
